# FlyLab brains — continuous training log

*Auto-generated by `train_brains.py`, last updated 2026-09-25T16:19:46.*

Every skill has its own brain and its own training process: surrogate ES rounds, physics validation in MuJoCo, keep-the-best selection, and a held-out physics test that is never used for selection. See each skill's report for its full round-by-round history. Mastery is progressive: passing a level (100% physics validation, >=95% surrogate) doubles the validation and test arena sets; a brain is **optimal** once it holds up at level 3.
